recentItems.description:

Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnY1FL_e1HO5XWdPdELWdlY54JJUI3962

Marriage consultant Humagear Match Enmusubi stands in at the mock wedding ceremony. However, at the venue Match is turned into a Magia, and on top of that even a Raider appears. Aruto succeeds at transforming into the forbidden Metal Cluster Hopper and stops the Magia and Raider, but unable to control the form he also goes berserk. Gai Amatsu arrives at this scene and transforms into Kamen Rider Thouser. As a battle unfolds between Thouser and Metal Cluster, the actor Humagear Enji Matsuda, who played the role of the priest in the mock wedding ceremony, gets taken over by the Ark’s power through Metal Cluster.

Thanks to the Metal Cluster key created by the Ark, Zero-One has successfully transformed into a new form. However, the Zero-One driver no longer authorizes other Progrise keys due to the Metal Cluster’s power. While Aruto is completely at a loss, a sudden and utterly unexpected visitor arrives! It’s Chiharu, the victim in the marriage fraud trial a few days prior. “Please find me a husband!” she asks with tremendous force. Aruto introduces her to marriage consultant Humagear Match Enmusubi.

However, Horobi and Jin appear in front of that hospital…

Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnY1FL_e1HO5XWdPdELWdlY54JJUI3962

The one who falls victim to Aruto’s revenge after his transformation into Ark-One is not Horobi but Jin. As his grief over the loss of Jin amplifies the malice inside him, will the Ark be created inside Horobi as well? If Aruto and Horobi battle again, it’s likely to turn into an all-out war between humans and Humagears. Starting with Isamu and the Kamen Riders, as well as the people of Hiden Intelligence, everyone gets into action to stop Aruto!

ZAIA has already gained two victories over Hiden in the “Five Jobs Contest” being held around the takeover of Hiden Intelligence. With no more chances left, the next challenge proposed to Hiden Intelligence is a decisive trial showdown. A public prosecutor using ZAIA Spec and an attorney Humagear will contend in a trial over a case of accused marriage fraud. If found guilty ZAIA will be the victor, and if found innocent Hiden will win. However, it seems like the prosecution has seized some conclusive evidence…

The TV drama project that Hiden has staked its future on has fallen into a crisis. “I can’t feel the profoundness of humanity,” says co-star Shinya Owada with distrust towards the performance of the Humagear actor Enji Matsuda, and he’s announced he will quit the show. Aruto starts to take action as the company president in order to persuade Owada. At the same time, the assassin Humagear whose acting was recognized by Owada and became his pupil, has been given the order, “assassinate Shinya Owada...”
